description: OASEES: Rust Detection Dataset for Critical 5G Infrastructure - UAV (Swarm) based is a model or code deposit deposited in Zenodo by its authors Averkios Vasalos, Andreas Oikonomakis (National Centre of Scientific Research "Demokritos"). Created as part of the EU‑funded OASEES initiative (Drones Use Case), this specialized dataset supports the development of reliable rust detection and corrosion monitoring models in critical 5G infrastructure environments. Edge-computing ready: Optimized for training lightweight neural networks deployable on edge devices and FPGA/NPU accelerators within the OASEES framework for on-site inference. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support communication-network and digital-infrastructure studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
